metadata.question: On July 7, was the year-to-date rainfall in the coastal city of La Serena lower than the 1990-2020 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in La Serena, Chile on July 7, comparing year-to-date rainfall to the 1990-2020 average for the same period (Jan 1-July 7). Key points: 1. Location: La Serena, Chile (coastal city) 2. Time period: Year-to-date (Jan 1 to July 7) vs 1990-2020 average for same period 3. Data needed: Precipitation data 4. Comparison: Is current YTD rainfall lower than historical average? I'll use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is a good precipitation dataset. Steps: 1. Define La Serena geometry (point with buffer) 2. Get current year YTD precipitation (Jan 1 to July 7 of current year) 3. Get historical YTD precipitation (1990-2020, Jan 1 to July 7 for each year) 4. Calculate average of historical period 5. Compare current vs historical average Need to handle: - Check if collections are empty - Check if valid pixels exist - Handle calculation failures ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laSerena = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.2520, -29.9027]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer around La Serena // Get current year and set date range for YTD (Jan 1 to July 7) const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear(); const currentStart = currentYear + '-01-01'; const currentEnd = currentYear + '-07-07'; const historicalStart = '1990-01-01'; const historicalEnd = '2020-07-07'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // Current year YTD precipitation const currentYTD = chirps .filterDate(currentStart, currentEnd) .filterBounds(laSerena); // Historical YTD precipitation (1990-2020) const historicalYTD = chirps .filterDate(historicalStart, historicalEnd) .filterBounds(laSerena); // Check if collections are empty const currentSize = currentYTD.size().getInfo(); const historicalSize = historicalYTD.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Current YTD (${currentYear}) images: ${currentSize}`); console.log(`Historical YTD (1990-2020) images: ${historicalSize}`); if (currentSize === 0 || historicalSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate total precipitation const currentSum = currentYTD.sum(); const historicalSum = historicalYTD.sum(); // Calculate mean of historical period const yearsInHistorical = 31; // 1990-2020 inclusive const historicalMean = historicalSum.divide(yearsInHistorical); // 4. Calculate regional means const currentPrecip = currentSum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const historicalMeanPrecip = historicalMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const currentVal = currentPrecip.getInfo(); const historicalVal = historicalMeanPrecip.getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (currentVal === null || historicalVal === null) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (!isFinite(currentVal) || !isFinite(historicalVal) || currentVal < 0 || historicalVal < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`Current YTD (${currentYear}): ${currentVal.toFixed(1)} mm`); console.log(`Historical avg (1990-2020): ${historicalVal.toFixed(1)} mm`); console.log(`Difference: ${(currentVal - historicalVal).toFixed(1)} mm`); if (currentVal < historicalVal) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
